steps.what: Prepare reports from stored claim figures.
Check every stored figure before the report is submitted.
Submit the accepted report to the company processing department.

tasks.design: The {DATA_PLATFORM} holds the claim figures already stored. Each figure in the report traces to one of those fields, and a missing figure is left out rather than invented. The claims adjuster checks the report. Only the report the adjuster accepts is submitted to the company's data processing department.
tasks.previous_blocker: A report went to processing with a total that no claim field contained.
tasks.enabler_now: Stored claim figures can be assembled. The check, and any sentence the fields do not state, still belong to the adjuster.
tasks.still_hard: A fact no claim field holds still has to be left out or written by the adjuster from a source the adjuster names.
tasks.human_edge: The adjuster checks the report. A missing figure is not a zero.
tasks.altitude: The check stays with the adjuster. The report is submitted only after that version is accepted.

reach.task: Process a report this adjuster has accepted.
reach.learn: A blank figure is not a zero.

evidence.claim: Assembling stored claim figures into a report is a copy of those fields. It does not check the report or invent a number.
Submitting a report before the adjuster accepts that version would send figures nobody checked.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: A claims adjuster in a mid-size European insurer. A stored claim file is not the decision, and a draft is not the accepted version.
Fields: The claim id and the figures already stored. A missing figure is omitted. No number is invented. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the claims adjuster finishes it by hand.
Native check: Copy stored figures and keep the claim id on each line. Do not fill a blank with a guess.
Any edit after approval voids the version and returns the item to the claims adjuster.
unknowns: Whether every processing report uses the same set of claim fields.
research_questions: Who in the company may receive the report, and which version?

already_counted.description: Checking the report before it is submitted stays with the adjuster.

incremental.description: Drop figures whose claim file has been withdrawn.

approvals.approved_version: claim ids, figure ids, and the report the adjuster accepted

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The adjuster still checks the report that will be submitted to the company's data processing department. Only assembling figures that were already stored on the claim, and submitting the report already accepted, is removed. A blank figure is omitted, not invented.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Show the stored title for this property.
Examine titles to determine validity in property transactions.

tasks.design: The {DOCS} store shows the title already on file. The claims adjuster examines it to determine validity and acts as the company agent in the transaction with the property owner. The title record does not determine validity. A title with no id leaves the examination with the adjuster.
tasks.previous_blocker: A title was treated as valid because a name was on the file, and the chain had not been examined.
tasks.enabler_now: The stored title can be opened. The examination and the transaction still belong to the adjuster.
tasks.still_hard: A break in the chain the record does not show still has to be found by the adjuster.
tasks.human_edge: The adjuster determines validity and acts in the transaction. The record is not that judgement.
tasks.altitude: The examination stays with the adjuster. Opening the title is not determining validity.

reach.task: Bring the chain this adjuster is examining.
reach.learn: A name on a file is not validity.

evidence.claim: Opening a stored title is a lookup. It does not determine validity or act for the company in a transaction.
A determination that a title is valid is not an automatic decision. The adjuster makes it.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: A claims adjuster in a mid-size European insurer. A stored claim file is not the decision, and a draft is not the accepted version.
Fields: The title id already stored. The screen does not mark the title valid or complete a transaction. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the claims adjuster finishes it by hand.
Native check: Open the title. Do not mark it valid.
unknowns: Whether residential and commercial titles share one record.
research_questions: Who confirms the title on file is the current one for this property?

already_counted.description: Examining the title and acting in the transaction stay with the adjuster.

incremental.description: Drop titles whose claim file has been withdrawn.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The adjuster still examines the title, still determines validity, and still acts as the company agent with the property owner. Only opening a title that was already stored is removed. A name on the file saves none of that examination.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Show the stored request before any credit contact.
Obtain credit information from banks or credit services.

tasks.design: The {DOCS} store shows the request already stored. The claims adjuster obtains credit information from the bank or the other credit service. The screen does not pull a credit score and does not invent a figure. A request with no bank named leaves the contact with the adjuster.
tasks.previous_blocker: A score was written on the file, and no bank had been asked.
tasks.enabler_now: The stored request can be opened. Obtaining the information still belongs to the adjuster.
tasks.still_hard: A figure the bank does not give still has to be left unknown.
tasks.human_edge: The adjuster obtains the information. The screen does not pull or calculate a score.
tasks.altitude: The contact stays with the adjuster. The stored request is only visible.

reach.task: Release information only to this adjuster on a proper request.
reach.learn: A request id is not a credit score.

evidence.claim: Opening a stored request is a lookup. It does not obtain credit information from a bank or a credit service.
Pulling or calculating a credit score would be a determining score about a person. This step does not do that.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: A claims adjuster in a mid-size European insurer. A stored claim file is not the decision, and a draft is not the accepted version.
Fields: The request id already stored. The screen does not write a score or a credit figure. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the claims adjuster finishes it by hand.
Native check: Open the request. Do not pull a score.
unknowns: Whether banks and other credit services are named on the same request.
research_questions: Who may record credit information, and against which person?

already_counted.description: Obtaining the credit information stays with the adjuster.

incremental.description: Drop requests whose claim file has been withdrawn.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The adjuster still obtains credit information from the bank or the other credit service. Only opening a request that was already stored is removed. The screen does not pull or invent a credit score.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Show the application before the background contact.
Communicate with former associates to verify an employment record.

tasks.design: The {DOCS} store shows the application already stored for the person or the business seeking credit. The claims adjuster communicates with the former associate to verify the employment record or to obtain background information. The screen does not make the call and does not invent a record. An application with no associate named leaves the contact with the adjuster.
tasks.previous_blocker: An employment record was marked verified because an application named an employer, and the associate had not been asked.
tasks.enabler_now: The stored application can be opened. The communication and the verification still belong to the adjuster.
tasks.still_hard: A fact the associate does not confirm still has to be left unverified.
tasks.human_edge: The adjuster verifies the record with the associate. The application is not that verification.
tasks.altitude: The contact stays with the adjuster. The screen does not create a background finding.

reach.task: Confirm a record only when this adjuster asks the associate.
reach.learn: An application is not a verification.

evidence.claim: Opening a stored application is a lookup. It does not communicate with a former associate or verify an employment record.
A background finding the associate did not give is not information. The screen must not add one.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: A claims adjuster in a mid-size European insurer. A stored claim file is not the decision, and a draft is not the accepted version.
Fields: The application id already stored. The verification is not added by the screen. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the claims adjuster finishes it by hand.
Native check: Open the application before the contact. Do not mark a record verified.
unknowns: Whether employment checks and other background checks share one application record.
research_questions: Who may record what the associate said, and against which person or business?

already_counted.description: Communicating with the associate and verifying the record stay with the adjuster.

incremental.description: Drop applications whose claim file has been withdrawn.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The adjuster still communicates with the former associate to verify the employment record or to obtain background information about the person or business applying for credit. Only opening an application that was already stored is removed. The screen does not invent the record.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The claims adjuster still checks the report, still examines the title, still obtains the credit information, and still verifies the employment. A stored figure can be opened. It does not make those calls.
reach: The data processing department receives a report only after this adjuster has accepted it.
Banks and former associates speak with this adjuster, and a screen does not pull a score.
skills_to_grow: Assemble a report only from stored claim figures. Do not invent a number.
Examine the title. Do not treat a name on a deed as validity.
Obtain credit and employment information from the person. Do not pull a score.
role.ambitious_version: Reports, titles, credit, and employment checks stay with the adjuster. Stored figures only show what was already recorded.
